name: Can I repair a toilet flange myself, or should I hire a professional plumber?

mainEntity.name: Can I repair a toilet flange myself, or should I hire a professional plumber?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor repairs like tightening bolts or replacing a wax ring can sometimes be done by a homeowner, extensive flange damage typically requires professional intervention. Repairing a cracked or corroded flange, or one that is below the finished floor level, involves specialized tools and expertise to ensure proper sealing and structural integrity. Incorrect DIY repairs can lead to ongoing leaks and more costly damage. CG Plumbing Solutions recommends professional assessment for complex issues to guarantee a lasting solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor repairs might be DIY, but significant flange damage often requires a professional plumber to ensure proper sealing and prevent future issues.
